cases.text: Doctor ne bola patients ko loyalty points aur referral rewards bhi chahiye.
Aur UPI ke saath credit cards bhi accept karne hain.
Reminders WhatsApp pe hi bhejna hai.
Booking confirm hone se pehle doctor ka approval zaroori hai.
Timeline ab 12 weeks kar do, 8 weeks mein nahi hoga.
Budget 3 lakh tak ja sakta hai, 1.5 lakh se kaam nahi chalega.
Advance payment nahi chahiye, patient clinic mein hi pay karega.
We also need a patient mobile app for iPhone and Android with video consultation.
